```{r}

library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tibble)
library(psych)
library(httr)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(systemfonts)
library(ragg)

theme_ipsum(base_size = 11, base_family = "Segoe UI")

```




```{r}




url <- "https://howtheyvote.eu/api/votes"

response <- VERB("GET", url, content_type("application/octet-stream"), accept("application/json"),
  query = list(page = 1, page_size = 200))

data <- content(response, "text") |>
  fromJSON(flatten = TRUE)

votes <- data$results




response <- VERB("GET", url, content_type("application/octet-stream"), accept("application/json"),
  query = list(page = 2, page_size = 200))

data <- content(response, "text") |>
  fromJSON(flatten = TRUE)

votes2 <- data$results

votes <- bind_rows(votes,votes2)

rm(votes2)




response <- VERB("GET", url, content_type("application/octet-stream"), accept("application/json"),
  query = list(page = 3, page_size = 200))

data <- content(response, "text") |>
  fromJSON(flatten = TRUE)

votes2 <- data$results

votes <- bind_rows(votes,votes2)

rm(votes2)





response <- VERB("GET", url, content_type("application/octet-stream"), accept("application/json"),
  query = list(page = 4, page_size = 200))

data <- content(response, "text") |>
  fromJSON(flatten = TRUE)

votes2 <- data$results

votes <- bind_rows(votes,votes2)

rm(votes2)






votes <- votes %>%
  filter(id > 169300)






```

```{r}




# Liste des IDs depuis votre df (adaptez le nom de la colonne)
vote_ids <- votes$id


url <- "https://github.com/HowTheyVote/data/releases/latest/download/member_votes.csv.gz"

tous_les_membres <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(vote_id %in% vote_ids)




url <- "https://github.com/HowTheyVote/data/releases/latest/download/members.csv.gz"

members <- read_csv(url, show_col_types = FALSE)



```

```{r}

members <- merge(tous_les_membres,members, by.x = "member_id", by.y = "id")

members <- merge(members,votes, by.x = "vote_id", by.y = "id")

```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Aplatir la colonne topics directement dans le df
votes_flat_topics <- votes |>
  unnest(topics, keep_empty = TRUE)

votes_flat_cntry <- votes |>
  unnest(geo_areas, keep_empty = TRUE)

votes_flat_comm <- votes |>
  unnest(responsible_committees, keep_empty = TRUE)

```

```{r}




members2 <- members%>%
  filter(position != "DID_NOT_VOTE")%>%
  mutate(
    Yes = ifelse(position == "FOR",1,0),
    No = ifelse(position == "AGAINST",1,0),
    Abs = ifelse(position == "ABSTENTION",1,0),
    Group_Country = paste(group_code,"_",country_code.x)
    )
  

```



```{r}


members <- members%>%
  mutate(
    Yes = ifelse(position == "FOR",1,0),
    No = ifelse(position == "AGAINST",1,0),
    Abs = ifelse(position %in% c("ABSTENTION","DID_NOT_VOTE"),1,0),
    Group_Country = paste(group_code,"_",country_code.x)
    )
  

```

#PCA

```{r}

library(psych)

members_pca <- members2 %>%
  mutate(position = Yes-No)%>%
  select(c(vote_id,member_id,country_code.x,group_code,first_name,last_name,Group_Country,position))

members_pca <- members_pca %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = vote_id,
              values_from = position)

members_pca2 <- members_pca %>%
  select(-c("member_id","country_code.x","group_code","first_name","last_name","Group_Country"))

members_pca2[is.na(members_pca2)] <- 0

pca_result <- principal(members_pca2, nfactors = 2, rotate = "none")
pca_result

factors <- as.data.frame(pca_result$scores)

members_pca2<-cbind(members_pca, factors)

PC1 <- members_pca2 %>%
  select(-c(member_id,country_code.x,group_code,first_name,last_name,Group_Country,PC2))



PC2 <- members_pca2 %>%
  select(-c(member_id,country_code.x,group_code,first_name,last_name,Group_Country,PC1))

members_pca2 <- members_pca2%>%
  select(c(member_id,country_code.x,group_code,first_name,last_name,Group_Country,PC1,PC2))





```

#Analyse Principal Components

```{r}

cor_PC1 <- cor(PC1$PC1, PC1[, -615], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_PC1 <- t(cor_PC1)
cor_PC1 <- data.frame(cor_PC1)

cor_PC1 <- rownames_to_column(cor_PC1, var = "vote_id")




cor_PC2 <- cor(PC2$PC2, PC2[, -615], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_PC2 <- t(cor_PC2)
cor_PC2 <- data.frame(cor_PC2)

cor_PC2 <- rownames_to_column(cor_PC2, var = "vote_id")




```

```{r}

cor_PC <- merge(cor_PC1,cor_PC2, by = "vote_id")

cor_PC <- cor_PC %>%
  filter(cor_PC1 > 0.7 | cor_PC2 > 0.7 | cor_PC1 < -0.7 | cor_PC2 < -0.7)

cor_PC <- merge(cor_PC,votes_flat_topics, by.x = "vote_id", by.y = "id")

```

```{r}


data_plot <- members_pca2 %>%
  mutate(
    couleur = case_when(
      group_code == "ESN" ~ "brown4",
      group_code == "PFE" ~ "black",
      group_code == "ECR" ~ "blue3",
      group_code == "EPP" ~ "skyblue2",
      group_code == "RENEW" ~ "orange",
      group_code == "SD" ~ "red",
      group_code == "GREEN_EFA" ~ "green3",
      group_code == "GUE_NGL" ~ "purple",
      group_code == "NI" ~ "grey"
    )
  )


ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = couleur)) +
  geom_point(alpha = ifelse(data_plot$country_code.x == "FRA", 1, 1)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.35) +
  scale_color_identity(
    guide  = "legend",
    name   = "Groupe",
    breaks = unique(data_plot$couleur),
    labels = unique(data_plot$group_code)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2))) +
  theme_ipsum(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Composant Principal 1 : Dimension Européenne",
    y = "Composant Principal 2 : Dimension Gauche-Droite",
    caption = "Données : howtheyvote.eu"
  )




ggplot(data_plot, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = couleur)) +
  geom_point(alpha = ifelse(data_plot$country_code.x == "FRA", 1, 0.08)) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.37) +
  scale_color_identity(
    guide  = "legend",
    name   = "Groupe",
    breaks = unique(data_plot$couleur),
    labels = unique(data_plot$group_code)
  ) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2))) +
  theme_ipsum(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Composant Principal 1 : Dimension Européenne",
    y = "Composant Principal 2 : Dimension Gauche-Droite",
    caption = "Données : howtheyvote.eu"
  )




```

```{r}


groupe1 <- data_plot %>%
  group_by(group_code)%>%
  summarise(
    PC1 = mean(PC1),
    PC2 = mean(PC2),
    nb_observations = n()
  )%>%
  mutate(
    Group_Country=group_code
  )



groupe2 <- data_plot %>%
  group_by(Group_Country,group_code)%>%
  summarise(
    PC1 = mean(PC1),
    PC2 = mean(PC2),
    nb_observations = n()
  )%>%
mutate(nb_observations = ifelse(Group_Country %in% c("EPP _ FRA","SD _ DNK","SD _ SWE","GREEN_EFA _ FRA","ECR _ FRA","ESN _ FRA"),6000,nb_observations))%>%
  filter(nb_observations > 7)%>%
  mutate(nb_observations = case_when(
    Group_Country == "EPP _ FRA" ~ 6,
    Group_Country == "SD _ DNK" ~ 3,
    Group_Country == "SD _ SWE" ~ 5,
    Group_Country == "GREEN_EFA _ FRA" ~ 5,
    Group_Country == "ECR _ FRA" ~ 4,
    Group_Country == "ESN _ FRA" ~ 1,
    TRUE ~ nb_observations))%>%
  filter(!(Group_Country %in% c("NI _ DEU")))
  

groupe <- bind_rows(groupe1,groupe2)


groupe <- groupe %>%
  mutate(
    couleur = case_when(
      group_code == "ESN" ~ "brown4",
      group_code == "PFE" ~ "black",
      group_code == "ECR" ~ "blue3",
      group_code == "EPP" ~ "skyblue2",
      group_code == "RENEW" ~ "orange",
      group_code == "SD" ~ "red",
      group_code == "GREEN_EFA" ~ "green3",
      group_code == "GUE_NGL" ~ "purple",
      group_code == "NI" ~ "grey"
    )
  )






ggplot(groupe, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = couleur)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_point(data = groupe, size = 1.5) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = groupe,
    aes(label = groupe$Group_Country),
    size = ifelse(groupe$Group_Country == "PFE _ FRA", 4, 2),
    fontface = ifelse(groupe$Group_Country == "PFE _ FRA", "bold", "plain"),
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 0.37) +
  scale_color_identity(
    name   = "Groupe",
    guide  = "legend",
    breaks = unique(groupe$couleur),
    labels = unique(groupe$group_code))+
theme_ipsum(base_size = 11, base_family = "sans") +
  labs(
    x = "Composant Principal 1 : Dimension Européenne",
    y = "CP 2 : Dimension Gauche-Droite",
    caption = "Données : howtheyvote.eu"
  )


```

#Tableau votes communs

```{r}



FarRight <- members2 %>%
  filter(Group_Country %in% c("PFE _ FRA"))%>%
  group_by(vote_id)%>%
  summarise(
    Yes = sum(Yes),
    No = sum(No)
  )%>%
  filter(Yes != No)%>%
  mutate(
    FR_Position = ifelse(Yes - No>0,"FOR","AGAINST")
  )%>%
  select(vote_id,FR_Position)



members3 <- merge(members2,FarRight, by = "vote_id")

members3 <- members3 %>% mutate(
  FR_Position2 = ifelse(FR_Position == "FOR",Yes,No)
)


members3 <- members3 %>%
  group_by(member_id,first_name,last_name,country_code.x,group_code,Group_Country)%>%
  summarise(nombre_vote = sum(Yes)+sum(No)+sum(Abs),
            FR_Position = sum(FR_Position2))%>%
  mutate(
    FR_Position = FR_Position/nombre_vote
  )%>%
  filter(nombre_vote > 10)


groupe1 <- members3 %>%
  group_by(group_code)%>%
  summarise(
    FR_Position = mean(FR_Position),
    nb_observations = n()
  )%>%
  mutate(
    Group_Country=group_code
  )%>%
  filter((!Group_Country %in% c("PFE","NI","ECR","ESN")))


groupe2 <- members3 %>%
  group_by(Group_Country,group_code)%>%
  summarise(
    FR_Position = mean(FR_Position),
    nb_observations = n()
  )%>%
  filter((Group_Country %in% c("PFE _ CZE","PFE _ HUN","PFE _ ITA","ECR _ POL","ECR _ ITA","ESN _ DEU","EPP _ FRA","RENEW _ FRA","SD _ FRA","GREEN_EFA _ FRA","GUE_NGL _ FRA")))
  

groupe2 <- bind_rows(groupe1,groupe2)




groupe2 <- groupe2 %>%
  mutate(
    couleur = case_when(
      group_code == "ESN" ~ "brown4",
      group_code == "PFE" ~ "black",
      group_code == "ECR" ~ "blue3",
      group_code == "EPP" ~ "skyblue2",
      group_code == "RENEW" ~ "orange",
      group_code == "SD" ~ "red",
      group_code == "GREEN_EFA" ~ "green3",
      group_code == "GUE_NGL" ~ "purple",
      group_code == "NI" ~ "grey"
    ),
    Stat = round(FR_Position*100,1)
  )




ggplot(groupe2,aes(y = reorder(Group_Country, FR_Position), x = Stat)) +
  geom_col(fill = groupe2$couleur) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Stat), vjust = 0.5, size = 3.5,hjust = -0.2) +
  labs(
    y = "Délégation",
    x = "Vote communs avec le RN (en %)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0))




```
